name: When a Cheap Redmond Refinishing Quote Costs You More Later
title-tag: Cheap Refinishing Quotes in Redmond: The Real Cost Later
meta-description: A too-cheap refinishing quote fails on a schedule: worn finish in 2–4 years, sanding marks, peeling. A Redmond contractor maps each shortcut to its later bill.
post-summary: January 29, 2027 · A refinishing quote far under market is a different job wearing the same name — fewer coats, bargain finish, rushed sanding — and it fails on a schedule you pay for twice. The failure-mode catalog, the 800 sq ft math, and five questions that expose a hollow bid before you sign.
